numbers.note: Numerical blocks classified individually as sourced, transparent arithmetic, procedure, or withdrawn claims.

model_ids.note: No guessed production model aliases; example-model is used only in offline mocks. Named model variants checked against linked cards where applicable.

pricing.note: Illustrative prices are labeled assumptions; product billing links are provided without treating a dated price as a universal contract.

dates_versions.note: Original publication date retained; substantial revision date recorded separately; version-sensitive statements tied to primary documentation.

benchmarks.note: Vendor results, original study findings, deterministic examples, and proposed evaluation protocols distinguished. No invented live product results.

sponsorship.note: No sponsored placement or affiliate destination introduced; existing target content inspected. Previously approved collaboration articles excluded.

cover.note: Existing cover visually inspected; topic remains accurate and contains no unsupported numerical performance claim.

commercial.note: Unpaid editorial correction; no placement agreement or paid link added by this change.
